original_text: I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way, so that others can learn about me.
final_text:
User Story:
As a profile owner, I want to showcase my personal information in a well-organized format on my profile page so that visitors can quickly grasp my background and interests.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Include distinct sections for essential information such as biography, skills, and interests.
- Ensure the design is intuitive and visually engaging.
- Facilitate straightforward updates to the displayed information.

Test Outline:
- Evaluate the page structure to ensure it is coherent and easy to navigate.
- Verify that all sections contain pertinent and accurate information.
- Test the update functionality for personal details to confirm it operates seamlessly.

original_text: I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner, so that I can earn that designation.
final_text:
User Story:
As an aspiring Scrum Practitioner, I aim to finalize my certification application to secure the official credential and bolster my professional qualifications.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully complete and submit the certification application form.
- Receive an acknowledgment confirming the application has been received.
- Attain certification status upon fulfilling all necessary criteria.

Test Outline:
- Ensure the application submission process is executed without any errors.
- Verify that a confirmation email is dispatched following the submission.
- Confirm that certification is awarded once all requirements are satisfied.

original_text: As a Practitioner, I want to include additional details about me in my profile page, so that I can showcase my experience.
final_text:
User Story:
As a Practitioner, I want to enrich my profile page with more comprehensive information about my background, so that I can effectively highlight my expertise and experience.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Provide fields for adding professional qualifications and certifications.
- Allow users to upload a portfolio or samples of work.
- Enable the inclusion of personal achievements and testimonials.

Test Outline:
- Verify that new fields for qualifications and certifications are present on the profile page.
- Confirm that users can successfully upload their portfolio or work samples.
- Check that personal achievements and testimonials can be added and displayed correctly.

original_text: As a site member, I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Trainer, so that I can teach CSM and CSPO courses and certify others.
final_text:
User Story:
As a registered site member, I want to complete an application to obtain certification as a Scrum Trainer, enabling me to instruct CSM and CSPO courses and certify aspiring professionals.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully submit the application form for Certified Scrum Trainer status.
- Receive confirmation of application receipt within 24 hours.
- Complete any required assessments or interviews as part of the certification process.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the application submission process is functional and user-friendly.
- Confirm that an acknowledgment email is sent upon application submission.
- Ensure that all necessary assessments or interviews are scheduled and completed.

original_text: As a Trainer, I want to include additional details in my profile page about me, so that others can learn about me and decide if I am the right trainer for them.
final_text:
User Story:
As a fitness trainer, I want to enrich my profile page with more personal information so that potential clients can better understand my qualifications and determine if I am the ideal trainer for their needs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Add sections for certifications, training specialties, and personal training philosophy.
- Include a professional photo and a brief introductory video.
- Ensure that the profile is easily editable for future updates.

Test Outline:
- Review the profile page to confirm that all new details are accurately displayed.
- Check that the profile is visually appealing and user-friendly.
- Test the edit functionality to ensure updates can be made seamlessly.
